title: Ukraine designates Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps as a terrorist organization
body:
On 2 February 2026, President Volodymyr Zelensky announced in his evening address that Ukraine had designated Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) as a terrorist organization. The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) said the group had been added to the formal list on 30 January. Zelensky said of the decision: "for us this issue is closed."

The move followed an earlier step by the European Union, which labelled the IRGC a terrorist group on 29 January 2026 and imposed new sanctions on Iran. The designations came after Iran's crackdown on anti-regime protests, which was believed to have killed thousands of demonstrators. The United States and several other countries already designated the IRGC as a terrorist organization.

The IRGC is an elite branch of Iran's armed forces established after the 1979 Iranian revolution. The Kyiv Independent noted that Iran has supplied Shahed strike drones, and that Russian-made copies of them are used by Russia in strikes on Ukrainian cities. The article also reported that US President Donald Trump was reportedly weighing a strike on Iran amid stalled talks on its nuclear program.
